Description / What Changed: Test a proper train/validation/test 3-way split (70/15/15 of normal data) against the leaky methodology used everywhere else (threshold + eval computed on data the model was trained on). Controlled comparison: same model (trained on 70% of normal data only), only the evaluation methodology differs between the two reported results.

Result Summary:
Honest (3-way) scored HIGHER F1 than leaky on all 3 datasets (opposite of the usual leakage assumption - gap driven by precision, not recall):
IED: honest F1=0.9168 vs leaky 0.8169
Smart Grid: honest F1=0.9530 vs leaky 0.8747
WBF: honest F1=0.9374 vs leaky 0.7937
Total time: 1733.28s (~29 min)
